from thursday (6 Aug): talking to the cleaner auntie completely changed my perspective. before that, i was blaming and hating my current situation and i would go home and scroll just to vent my unhappiness...

then, i was this cleaning auntie whom i saw dressing up in the toilet before ending work. I have seen her ended work in outside clothes and put on make up the day before, so i casually asked her "are you going out?", which she replied "no im going home". I mused back "and you got all dressed up?" as she stops applying her lipstick and explained " yes, to take off the dirty work clothes and go home feeling fresh".

that hit me.

why should i bring the negative energy back home? why should i suffer? why do i feel this way? why is my perspective so skewed?

a simple switch in mentality can help me live lighter and happier.

i can be working in a bad environment. but that wouldn't define me. i am who i choose to be at work and outside of work. this is something i can change and im in full control of.
